_evidence: 0x0055a9b5: 'mov ebx,[0x891504]; or byte [ebx+0x92],8' sets bit 3 of the segment flag byte +0x92 of the lap-start record. [0x891504] is a record-aligned pointer into the 0x160-byte ring at 0x8943a0 (lap start; ring_008943a0 draws it 0..4, ring_0040aec5 pinned it to record 0), drawn here over records 0..29, and byte +0x92 of those records is random (an OR is valid for any byte; ebx and the flags of the OR are the outputs).
